# Diagrams demo

---

## Diagrams

A flowchart with an accessible title, wide enough to get a narrow layout:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  accTitle: How a page is published
  accDescr: The author writes markdown, moss builds it, the reader reads it.
  A[Write markdown] --> B{Has a diagram?}
  B -->|yes| C[Draw it]
  B -->|no| D[Plain page]
  C --> E[Publish]
  D --> E
```

A chart with no title of its own:

~~~mermaid
pie
  "Words" : 60
  "Pictures" : 30
  "Diagrams" : 10
~~~

A title from the diagram's own front matter:

```mermaid
---
title: Two states
---
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> Draft
  Draft --> Published
```

> [!note] Inside a callout
> ```mermaid
> sequenceDiagram
>   Reader->>Site: open page
>   Site-->>Reader: diagram
> ```

A broken diagram keeps its source:

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A --> B
  B -->
```

Labels and links that try to inject markup:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A["<script>alert(1)</script>"] --> B["<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>"]
  click A "javascript:alert(1)"
  click B "https://example.com/safe"
```

Obsidian note links: one names a page, one names nothing:

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  H[index] --> M[No such note]
  class H,M internal-link;
```

An ordinary code block is untouched:

```rust
fn main() {}
```
